title: abba - Atorus Batch Backend API
text: abba manages remote batch execution R programs across distributed computing environments (Kubernetes, SLURM, Posit Workbench) simple programming interface security identity segregation via API abstraction. title: abba - Atorus Batch Backend API
text: Three-layer design: End-user layer (R/api_requests.R, R/batch_submission.R) - Functions users call submit jobs via Posit Connect-hosted plumber API. Authentication via ABBA_API_ADDRESS ABBA_API_KEY environment variables. API layer (inst/plumber.R template) - Plumber REST API deployed Posit Connect. Validates requests, enforces container permissions, delegates local execution functions. Template created via create_batch_api(). Local execution layer - Cluster-specific functions run server-side: Kubernetes: R/submit_job_k8s.R - uses kubectl via system2() SLURM: R/submit_job_slurm.R, R/slurm_utils.R - uses sbatch/scontrol/sacct/squeue via system2() Posit Workbench: R/submit_job_workbench.R - uses rstudioapi::launcherSubmitJob()
